title: Preserve split UTF-8 characters in the MCP dogfood client
outcome: Decode MCP stdout and stderr incrementally so pipe chunk boundaries cannot corrupt valid UTF-8 or cause false full-contract parity failures.
acceptance: A deterministic regression splits multibyte UTF-8 across pipe/data chunks and exercises the actual MCP client framing; content text and structuredContent remain exact and equal after JSON parsing.
Stdout and diagnostic stderr preserve multibyte characters across chunk boundaries without weakening JSON framing, parity assertions or diagnostic handling.
The focused harness checks pass and the affected full authored-contract scenario passes on a scheduled qualified candidate; normal review and gate rules apply.
